members.subtitle: {space} · {currency} · {policy}
members.readOnlyNote: Your role in {space} is {role}: you can see members, balances and dashboards, but not invite or add guests.
members.directNote: {space} is a space for two: it takes no other members.

roleSheet.title: {name}'s role in {space}
roleSheet.label: Role
roleSheet.lock: Only the Owner changes roles. Owner is not assigned here.

roleDetail.ADMIN: Invites, runs the plan and edits everyone's entries
roleDetail.MEMBER: Records expenses and payments, adds guests
roleDetail.VIEWER: Only sees transactions, balances and dashboards

inviteSheet.title: Invite to {space}
inviteSheet.ownerNote: Nobody joins as Owner: that role is changed from Members.
inviteSheet.emailHint: Only that account can accept it, once, within 7 days.
inviteSheet.linkNote: Role {role} · expires on {date}. Several people can use it until it expires or you revoke it.
inviteSheet.linkNoteSingle: Role {role} · expires on {date}. Only one person can use it: it stops working once someone joins.
inviteSheet.notSent: Hearth does not send email yet: copy the link and share it with {email}.

members.pendingUses: {count, plural, one {Used by {people} person} other {Used by {people} people}}

guest.claimTitle: A link for {name} to claim their place
guest.claimBody: Signing up or signing in with this link moves their guest place, with all its history in {space}, to their account, as a Member.
guest.blocked: You can't remove {name}: they have an outstanding balance of {amount}. Record the payment first.
guest.confirmBody: Their balance is {amount}. Their history stays in the transactions under their name.

balances.title: Balances
balances.suggestionsNote: Everyone pays back whoever paid for them. Settle only fills in the form.
balances.personalNote: {space} is yours alone: there is nothing to settle here.

history.title: {name}'s history
history.summary: Balance at the start and at the end
history.empty: Nothing changed their balance in this period.
history.note: On the right, the balance after each movement and, under it, how much it changed.

settle.title: Settle
settle.debt: {payer} owes {receiver} {amount}. You can record a partial payment; paying more turns the debt around.
settle.guestNote: {name} is a guest: they paid outside the app, so there is no source account.
settle.recorded: You note that {payer} paid {receiver} {amount} outside the app. Nothing leaves your accounts.
settle.recordedFree: You note that {payer} paid {receiver} {amount}{settles, select, yes {: both are settled up} other {}}. Both who pays and who receives are chosen; neither is fixed.
settle.payingFor: {settles, select, yes {You pay {receiver} {amount} for {debtor}. {receiver} is settled up and {debtor} now owes you {amount}.} other {You pay {receiver} {amount} for {debtor}, and {debtor} now owes you {amount}.}}
settle.givingFor: {settles, select, yes {You pay {receiver} {amount} for {debtor} as a gift. {receiver} and {debtor} are settled up; nobody owes you.} other {You pay {receiver} {amount} for {debtor} as a gift; nobody owes you.}}

forgive.title: Forgive {name}'s debt?
forgive.subtitle: {space} · {debtor} owes {receiver} {amount}
forgive.noteGuest: {settles, select, yes {{debtor} is settled up and {receiver} no longer gets {amount}.} other {{receiver} no longer gets {amount} from {debtor}.}} No money moves. Only who collects forgives; since {receiver} is a guest, whoever manages {space} does it.
forgive.noteMine: {settles, select, yes {{debtor} is settled up and you no longer get {amount}.} other {You no longer get {amount} from {debtor}.}} No money moves. Only who collects forgives.
